entries.subject: DAMIT 5322: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 5322, version 2019-10-23, pole (332°, 45°), period 9.965 h, taken unchanged from the archive. Mirror solution 5323 recorded as an alternative.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 108.894 ± 0.312 km, effective diameter of a sphere fitted to thermal infrared measurements. JPL lists a diameter of 108.894 ± 0.312 km, from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2014, ApJ 791, 121; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). The thermal sphere diameter is transferred to the mesh as its volume-equivalent diameter.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: Shown size Display reference radius "54.45 km (size-calibrated model)" (jpl-small-body-database) differs from the Small Bodies Occultations V4.0 record 236, DAMIT model 5322 diameter 113 ± 3 km (volume-equivalent; DAMIT model 5322 fitted to 3 occultations); the shown value is kept.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.

entries.subject: Thia whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 13 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.937 at 462 nm, 0.964 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#242423 in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 1.8% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 0.7%), from NEOWISE (Nugent et al. 2016, AJ 152, 63; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
